category: Combat, V.A.T.S., Action Points, and Damage Calculation Engine

actionPointMechanics.baseRecoveryRate: 6.0% of total Action Point pool per second when not sprinting, jumping, or in V.A.T.S.
actionPointMechanics.recoveryDelay: 1.0 second delay after stopping AP consumption before passive regeneration begins.
actionPointMechanics.agilityScaling: Each point of Agility adds +10 Maximum Action Points.
actionPointMechanics.armorModPowered: +5.0 AP/second flat regeneration per piece (Up to +25.0 AP/second across 5 armor pieces).
actionPointMechanics.cannedCoffeeBurst: +12.0 AP/second for 25 seconds per can. Consuming multiple cans stacks multiplicatively, allowing continuous firing in V.A.T.S. without dropping out.

vatsMechanics.maximumHitChanceCap: 95% (Hit chance in V.A.T.S. can never exceed 95%, regardless of Perception or weapon accuracy buffs).
vatsMechanics.minimumHitChanceFloor: 0% (Unless line-of-sight is established, minimum floor is 0%).
vatsMechanics.rangeFalloff: Accuracy scales down dramatically past the weapon's listed effective range stat. Concentrated Fire perk increases hit chance by 10% / 15% / 20% on consecutive shots per target limb.
vatsMechanics.criticalHitFormula: V.A.T.S. criticals guarantee a 100% hit (ignoring accuracy falloff) and bypass non-boss flat damage reductions. Critical meter fills based on Luck: at 33 Luck with Critical Savvy Rank 3 (55% fill cost), a critical hit can be executed on every alternate shot (1 normal shot -> 1 crit -> 1 normal shot -> 1 crit).

damageMitigationAndPenetration.antiArmorCalculation: Anti-Armor reduces target's Armor and Energy Resistance by 50%. Combined with Tank Killer (+36% armor penetration) or Stabilized (+45% in PA), effective target resistance drops by up to ~68%–72.5%.
damageMitigationAndPenetration.damageAdditiveVsMultiplicative: Standard perks (Commando, Rifleman, Heavy Gunner) apply additive bonuses to weapon base damage. Vulnerability effects (Follow Through, Taking One for the Team) apply multiplicative final damage increases.
